newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Brussels bourse says Jan volume at nine-year high.
newsitem.headline: Brussels bourse says Jan volume at nine-year high.

text.p: The Brussels stock exchange said on Monday volume of trading over the month of January reached its highest level in value terms since 1988.
Total volumes traded - of domestic and foreign shares - amounted to 93.35 billion Belgian francs, the highest level since 1988 when a monthly volume of 98 billion francs was recorded.
The highest volume figure touched in 1996 was 87 billion in the month of March, the exchange said in a statement.
At the end of last month market capitalisation of the Brussels bourse, one of Europe's smaller stock exchanges, amounted to 4,097 billion francs.
